description: This is a PHP class defining a model for managing bestseller products in an OpenCart module. It includes methods to install/uninstall the database table, update product totals, delete entries, retrieve reports, and get total count.

classes.name: Bestseller
classes.description: Model class for managing bestseller product data in the database, including installation, record updates, deletion, and retrieval of reports.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Creates the 'product_bestseller' table in the database if it does not exist.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Drops the 'product_bestseller' table from the database if it exists.

methods.name: editTotal
methods.description: Replaces or inserts the total sales count for a specific product identified by product_id.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes the bestseller record for a specific product.

methods.name: getReports
methods.description: Retrieves a list of bestseller products ordered by total sales, supporting pagination with start and limit.

methods.name: getTotalReports
methods.description: Returns the total number of bestseller product records in the database.
